**Updated Summary:** 1. **Goal and done-criteria**: Implement 3 milestones in `markdown/extensions/toc.py`: - **m1** ✅ DONE & COMMITTED: Added `striptags`, `render_inner_html`, `run_postprocessors` functions. `striptags` uses regex `re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)` to strip tags without unescaping entities. - **m2** 🔄 IN PROGRESS: Modified `TocTreeprocessor.run` to use new helpers. Footnote refs are skipped in `render_inner_html` by checking `child.tag == 'sup' and 'fnref' in child.get('id', '')`. Slugify now uses `unescape(text)` instead of `html.unescape(text)`. Test shows footnote stripping works (`name: 'Header with footnote'`). BUT two tests fail: - `test_escaped_char_in_id`: TOC link text shows `escaped\x0295\x03character` (raw escape codes) instead of `escaped_character`. ID is correct. - `test_escaped_code`: ID is `lttestgt` instead of `test`. Code element content not handled properly. - **m3** ⏳ PENDING: Save `name`/`html`/`data-toc-label` tokens; apply `html.unescape` only before `slugify`. 2. **Constraints and rules**: Same as before. One commit per milestone. No test file changes. Run full test suite after each milestone. 3. **Test results**: - Pre-existing failures (4): `test_raw_missing_close_bracket`, `test_raw_unclosed_tag_in_code_span_space`, `test_unclosed_comment_` in `test_html_blocks.py`. - NEW failures (2): `test_escaped_char_in_id` and `test_escaped_code` in `test_toc.py`. - Passing: 691 tests, 130 skipped. 4. **Current bugs in m2**: - **Bug A**: `test_escaped_char_in_id` — TOC link text has raw STX/ETX escape sequences (`\x0295\x03`) instead of decoded `_`. The `name` field in toc_tokens isn't being fully processed. - **Bug B**: `test_escaped_code` — ID is `lttestgt` instead of `test`. When processing `<test>`, `render_inner_html` returns `
<test>
`, `striptags` strips `` tags leaving `<test>`, then `slugify` strips remaining `<>` to produce `lttestgt`. 5. **Pending items**: - Fix m2: ensure `name` goes through `unescape()` for proper decoding of STX/ETX sequences, and handle code elements properly in the slugify path. - Commit m2 once fixed. - Implement m3: add `html` and `data-toc-label` keys to `toc_tokens` entries. - Verify all tests pass after m3. 6. **Key code locations**: - `striptags` at line ~108: `return re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)` - `render_inner_html` at line ~112: wraps elem.text + children, skips fnref sup elements - `run_postprocessors` at line ~130: iterates `md.postprocessors` - `TocTreeprocessor.run` at line ~317: modified to use new helpers - `unescape` function at line ~95: calls `UnescapeTreeprocessor().unescape(text)` to decode STX/ETX sequences - `slugify` on TocTreeprocessor instance: called with `self.slugify(unescape(text), self.sep)` 7. **Next step**: Examine the current `run` method to understand why `name` retains raw escape codes and how code elements are processed. Need to trace the exact value of `text` at each stage and ensure `unescape()` is applied correctly to both the slugify input AND the name token.
